build_w2l_conv_glu_encoder_model: build a wav2letter convolutional GLU encoder model for speech recognition with configurable conv layers
create_w2l_conv_glu_encoder: create a W2lConvGluEncoder instance with vocab size, input features, and convolutional layer configuration
run_encoder_forward_pass: run a forward pass through the W2lConvGluEncoder with source tokens and sequence lengths
review_conv_enc_config: review the default convolutional encoder configuration with 17 layers of increasing channel dimensions
test_reorder_encoder_output: test the reorder_encoder_out method to reorder encoder output tensors by a new batch order
